In order for our application to work with Java 21 we need to install the OpenJDK 21 on our machine and make it available After this we can configure in Intellij that our project uses java 21 by pointing to use /Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/jdk-21 folder as the source for the JDK. 1. Start the dynamodb-init Docker container. 2. Open the "Database" sidebar in IntelliJ and click the plus icon. 3. Select DynamoDB as the data source and fill in with the following details then connect: 5. The table(s) present in the Dockerised DynamoDB should now be visible in the Database sidebar. 6. There will be no items in the table unless you populate it somehow, either using a PPA endpoint, or manually interacting with the database.
